title: Django 6.x Native Background Tasks Architecture & Result Backend Contracts

claims.assertion: Background task execution subsystems must decouple task definition decorators from pluggable backend engines (immediate, DB, Redis) with standardized TaskResult lifecycle state machines

context: Traditional web frameworks rely on heavy external third-party task queues (Celery, Dramatiq) with inconsistent configuration semantics, impeding lightweight background execution and unit testability.
